`#Overflow(mode)`, the fixed-width overflow mode of one function, method or block body
`#MaxDepth(n)`, the recursion depth bound the stack bound counts
`#ContextKey`, a package's own key for the task context
`#Deadline(limit)`, the one way to bound the waits of a block or function body
`TypeId{T}`, a type the module sees written as a value where a `TypeId` is expected
`meta.find_type(text)`, a type lookup by its spelling on a `Compiler` value
`name := value`, a mutable module global starting from a value computed while building
`#Pre(#run { … }, "…")`, a marker expression wrapped in `#run` whose answer is required while building
`#On(.Deep)`, the statement switch that turns on the deep checks of a block or function body
